title: Tableau constants lie below the base
statement: For every finite-state Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input and output, all natural numbers $n,t$, and every Boolean value $b$, the index assigned to the constant $b$—namely $n$ for false and $n+1$ for true—is strictly less than the tableau base $n+2+tW$, where $W$ is the tableau width determined by $M$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine $M$ over Boolean symbols
